name: Mo Shang Shaonian
source:
A wall on both sides.
Inside, the temple wall, outside, the world.
The helpless fate of both those inside and outside the wall.

Where is life?

[Translated from [url=http://www.nvlmaker.net/tobestill/gamemoshang.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
两面都是墙。
墙内是寺庙，墙外是世界。
墙内外之人的无力命运。

生命究竟在哪里？

[译自[url=http://www.nvlmaker.net/tobestill/gamemoshang.html]官方网站[/url]]
